#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    std::vector<int> runLengths;
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        size_t start = i;
        char ch = s[i];
        while (i < s.length() && s[i] == ch) {
            ++i;
        }
        runLengths.push_back(i - start);
    }
    int count = 0;
    for (int len : runLengths) {
        if ((len & 1) == 0) {
            ++count;
        }
    }
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
